summary.name: nef
summary.one_liner: nef is a tool for compile-time verification and documentation generation from Xcode Playgrounds, described as "steroids for Xcode Playgrounds".
use_cases: verify Xcode Playgrounds at compile time
compile Playgrounds that use third-party libraries from the command line
generate Playground Books from Swift packages
generate Markdown documentation from a nef Playground
build a Jekyll microsite from Playgrounds
summary.what_it_does: nef verifies Xcode Playgrounds at compile time and eases creating Playgrounds that use third-party libraries. It can compile Playgrounds with third-party library support from the command line. It generates Playground Books from Swift packages and Markdown files from a nef Playground. It also integrates Playgrounds with Carbon for exporting code snippets and with Jekyll for creating a microsite. The page lists documentation, API reference, GitHub, and license links.
notable: Command-line compilation of Playgrounds with third-party libraries
Generates Playground Books and Markdown from Swift code
Designed and developed with support from 47 Degrees
caveats: The page is a recovered Wayback Machine copy, so it may be outdated.
